summary: Separate email quoted history, add exact deterministic workflow relationships, and add customer-configured read-only Autodesk APS and Procore selected-file imports through existing chunk, hash and deduplication controls.
decision_refs: User request to improve efficiency, accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and email content
User authorization to access Autodesk and Procore APIs to reduce manual imports
User /ponytail instruction to prefer existing open-source components over new code
approval_evidence: The user explicitly authorized Autodesk and Procore access and instructed CIRP to minimize custom code with /ponytail.
known_limitations: The connector accepts a customer-generated bearer token; interactive OAuth, refresh and provider-side revocation are not implemented yet.
Imports are selected-file only; recursive bulk import, change polling and continuous synchronization are not implemented.
Only exact identifiers create workflow relationships; semantic relationship inference and authority adjudication remain human review tasks.
Validation uses synthetic MockTransport responses only; no live Autodesk/Procore tenant or customer file was used.
